title: Multistep and Multivariate Time Series Explainability with GradientSHAP: A Wind Power Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.40330v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As the effects of climate change become increasingly apparent, the demand for renewable energy sources such as wind power continues to grow. However, renewables' variable and intermittent nature presents significant challenges in their integration into energy grids. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a powerful tool to address these issues. Still, its adoption in the energy sector has been hindered by the opacity of many AI models, which often function as black boxes. This paper introduces a carefully adapted GradientSHAP approach to provide interpretability for multivariate, multistep wind power forecasting -- a largely underexplored area. This capability is critical for day-ahead grid management and, to the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to apply GradientSHAP in the context of wind power forecasting. translated_title: 基于GradientSHAP的多步多变量时间序列可解释性研究：以风电为案例
translated_abstract: 随着气候变化的影响日益显现，对风能等可再生能源的需求持续增长。然而，可再生能源的多变性和间歇性给其并入电网带来了重大挑战。人工智能（AI）已成为解决这些问题的强大工具，但许多AI模型的不透明性——它们通常以黑箱方式运行——阻碍了其在能源领域的应用。本文介绍了一种经过精心适配的GradientSHAP方法，为多变量、多步风电预测提供可解释性——这是一个在很大程度上尚未被充分探索的领域。这种能力对日前电网管理至关重要，据我们所知，这是首个将GradientSHAP应用于风电预测场景的研究。为应对固有的高维性问题，我们开发了新颖的可视化方法，能够同时提供局部和全局解释。
tldr: 本文首次将GradientSHAP方法应用于多变量多步风电预测的可解释性分析，并开发了新颖的局部与全局可视化方法，为日前电网管理提供支持。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to apply GradientSHAP for interpretability in multivariate, multistep wind power forecasting, developing novel visualizations that provide both local and global explanations to support day-ahead grid management.
